title: Asset Manifest
description: Inventory of generated/sourced assets produced by the Asset Generator.

path.description: Relative path within the pipeline project directory

generation_summary.description: Brief summary of how the asset was generated or sourced

original_url.description: Source URL if downloaded from a stock service

voice_performance.description: Applied voice-performance contract for narration assets.

img2img_source.description: Path to the init_image used for img2img generation. Required by pipelines that enforce img2img (e.g. fabric-promotion). Null/absent for non-img2img assets.

linked_concept_id.description: Identifier linking this asset to a concept/act in the brief (e.g. concept A/B/C, or 0 for fabric macro / cover base). Used by fabric-promotion and similar pipelines that tie assets to specific brief concepts.

kind.description: Pipeline-specific sub-classification complementing 'type' and 'subtype'. Examples for fabric-promotion: narration_wav, narration_timestamps, garment_image, garment_video, fabric_macro_video, cover_base_image.

layer.description: VOX paper-collage layer this asset belongs to (L1 bg / L2 hero / L3 element / L4 decor). Required for vox-paper-collage pipeline.

element_role.description: Role of this asset in the A3 production unit: beat full collage, independent element PNG, multi-grid reference, background texture, composed-scene reference, or thumbnail candidate.

derived_from.description: Path of the image used as img2img reference when generating this asset (e.g. the beat full collage for independent elements, or the real photo for real_content restyles).

library_ref.description: Path in assets/shared_library/ if this asset came from or was archived to the Global Asset Library.

data_class.description: VOX paper-collage data authenticity class for this asset. real_data must trace to a real data source; real_content must trace to a real photo.

data_source.description: Real data source or photo source for real_data / real_content assets.

multi_grid_refs.description: Paths to multi-grid reference images (e.g. 2x3 composed-scene previews) for user visual approval before element splitting.

missing_photos.description: real_content elements whose real photos could not be found. Submitted to user for decision (C7) before continuing.

timing_calibration_ref.description: TTS timing calibration record linking assets stage to scene_plan timing update.
